lessons_used: Reordering the onboarding flow and adding preset fallback choices were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, waiting info, hints, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions for preset fallback choices were underestimated.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, hint notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and waiting info.

candidates.title: Pre-Built Pet Archetype Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a streamlined sub-flow on the pick friend step with pre-configured pet archetypes to skip complex photo uploads.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (65.6%) and a high average completion time (mean 1017s), alongside 3 support complaints regarding custom pet generation errors.

pick_friend.headline: Select a Pre-Built Pet Archetype
pick_friend.body: Choose a ready-to-use pet archetype to ensure instant desktop setup and prevent generation issues.

guard.reason: Valid sub-flow addition inside onboarding on the pick_friend step that preserves the step's core function.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with support evidence; preset flow changes historically perform well.

candidates.title: Desktop Compatibility Check Screen
candidates.change: Insert a system compatibility verification screen right after the story step to verify graphics rendering before onboarding choices.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported the sign-in screen stalling (2 emails) or the pet failing to show on desktop/app failing to open (3 emails).

new_system_check.headline: Checking System Compatibility
new_system_check.body: Verifying desktop display permissions and graphics driver readiness...

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new diagnostic screen inside onboarding without removing or skipping any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new verification screens adds friction and requires a full app release.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Behavior Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro step into a multi-step behavior showcase stage where users test pet movements and docking controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on how to control/hide/talk to pets, 4 reported desktop feature misbehavior, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Test Pet Behaviors On Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Try moving and docking your desktop pet before finishing setup.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Shift
candidates.change: Move sign-in to occur right after the adoption certificate is generated, ensuring pet data is locked to the account prior to waiting.
candidates.why: 8 users reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, suggesting account binding should happen after pet attributes are finalized.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption_certificate is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major data loss issue; flow reordering has proven highly effective.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Warmup Activity Screen
candidates.change: Add an engaging warmup screen before waiting that prepares desktop workspace boundaries.
candidates.why: The home stage waiting process suffers from long completion times (mean 2336s) causing user attrition prior to completing setup.

new_warmup_screen.headline: Preparing Workspace Boundaries
new_warmup_screen.body: Your pet is getting familiar with your screen layout.

guard.reason: Adding a new warmup screen inside onboarding before waiting is allowed and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: New interactive warmup screen adds friction and new screen changes tend to reduce conversion.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Restored Indicator
candidates.change: Add a prominent cloud save status badge and clear indicator on the sign-in screen explaining account recovery.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores previously adopted pets linked to your email.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Background Pet Render Status Indicators
candidates.change: Display explicit multi-phase progress step counters on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean time of 2336s and 201s median, leading to user drop-offs before reaching final onboarding finish.

waiting.headline: Rendering Desktop Pet Assets
waiting.body: Building animations, interaction collision maps, and sound profiles.

guard.reason: Adding progress and step counters to the waiting screen maintains its core job of showing pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Waiting info tweaks show limited effect historically with low overall lift.

candidates.title: Two-Column Photo Picker and Live Style Switcher
candidates.change: Switch upload_photos layout to a split view pairing photo selection directly alongside style options.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (65.6%) and takes 1017s mean time; 3 users reported generation failures or visual artifacts.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photo & Select Art Style
upload_photos.body: Choose a clear photo and select how your pet should render on desktop.

candidates.title: Desktop Taskbar Pinning Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Provide a helpful hint on home_intro explaining desktop taskbar access and pet control options.
candidates.why: 3 emails cited confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 3 cited issues with pet visibility on desktop.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop or use the taskbar icon to manage settings anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop taskbar guidance hint to home_intro is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses clear user complaints at low drop-off step, though hints have modest impact.

candidates.title: Quick-Start Path Fast-Track Badge
candidates.change: Add a prominent fast-track badge to the pre-made path option to encourage faster path decision making.
candidates.why: Path selection takes up to 514s mean time, creating initial drop-off before sign-in and adoption.

lessons_next: Reordering the onboarding flow, adding preset fallback choices, and adding background render status indicators were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, hints, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated for preset fallback choices and background status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, hint notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and new flow additions.
